## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what triggers the issue or what the feature enables. Link the Jira ticket.

## Scope and dependencies

Identify the affected feature, branch dependencies, and any acceptance work left.

## Validation performed

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish code inspection,
targeted automated checks, and a full manual route. Include failures and limitations.

## Reviewer focus

Give a short reproducible procedure and the expected result. Identify the important
code paths or integration risks. Request a teammate review before merging.

## Review response

When feedback arrives, link or reply to it and explain the change or reason for
keeping the current approach. Reviewers: record what you inspected/tested and
specific observations, including any remaining concern.
